mcqs.question: During the Prime Minister’s Slovakia visit in June 2026, who was the Prime Minister of Slovakia?
mcqs.explanation: Robert Fico was the Prime Minister of Slovakia during the visit. Emmanuel Macron was associated with France, while Vinay Mohan Kwatra was the Indian Ambassador involved in the Chicago statue unveiling.

mcqs.question: The ASI–National Museum of Denmark MoU concerned the exploration of the wreck of which Danish ship that sank in 1619?
mcqs.explanation: The MoU concerned the wreck of the Danish ship Øresund, which sank in 1619 near Karaikal in Puducherry. Safran was associated with a separate India–France geospatial intelligence MoU, while ATL Bridge was an innovation initiative.

mcqs.question:
Assertion (A): Safran and SatSure signed an MoU on AI geospatial intelligence.
Reason (R): The MoU was signed with the National Museum of Denmark to explore the wreck of the ship Øresund.
options: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true, but R is NOT the correct explanation of A
A is true, but R is false
A is false, but R is true
mcqs.explanation: Assertion A is true because Safran and SatSure signed an MoU on AI geospatial intelligence under the France–India Year of Innovation. Reason R is false: the National Museum of Denmark MoU concerned the Øresund shipwreck, not the Safran–SatSure agreement.

mcqs.question:
Match the cultural diplomacy initiative in List-I with its associated venue or location in List-II.

List-I
(a) Vande Mataram 150 years event
(b) Swami Vivekananda statue
(c) Shivaji statue
(d) Sushruta statue

List-II
(i) Dubai
(ii) Indian Consulate, Chicago
(iii) Israel
(iv) Royal College of Surgeons of Edinburgh
mcqs.explanation: The correct pairs are a-i, b-ii, c-iii and d-iv: the Vande Mataram event was held in Dubai, the Vivekananda statue was unveiled at the Indian Consulate in Chicago, the Shivaji statue was installed in Israel, and the Sushruta statue was placed at the Royal College of Surgeons of Edinburgh. The other codes interchange these venues and locations.

mcqs.question: How many outcomes were approved under the India–France Innovation Roadmap 2030 at Nice on 14 June 2026?
mcqs.explanation: The India–France Innovation Roadmap 2030 approved at Nice included 13 outcomes. The number 64 refers to the session of the UNFCCC Subsidiary Bodies, while 40 billion and 120 billion dollars relate to adaptation finance.
